fields.Name: T099 - Query Status Filter Chips
fields.Description: Exercises toggleStatusFilter + applyFilters + buildCategoryTree status-filtering path (approved-vs-pending gating), not the search box or generic grid filter — unique to the query catalog's status-chip UI.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to Data Explorer, then open the Queries section. The left query panel shows a row of status filter chips (Approved, Pending, Rejected, Expired) each with a count badge; by default only 'Approved' is toggled on. Click the 'Pending' chip to toggle it on, then click 'Approved' to toggle it off. Success is seeing the visible query tree RESPOND to the chip toggles — the set of queries shown changes to match the active status filters (or a valid empty tree appears if no queries have that status). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A status filter chip bar with Approved/Pending/Rejected/Expired chips and count badges is visible above the query tree
Toggling a status chip on/off visibly changes which queries appear in the tree (the active chips gain/lose their highlighted state), OR a valid empty state appears when no queries match
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
